neighbours.label: the quantity being divided in a quotient or rate: the numerator before '/' in formulas and code (v/t, length/time, total / count) and 'X in Y hours, or … per hour'; not multiplication, and not '/' as a path or 'and/or'
fire: Current is found from Ohm's law as voltage divided by resistance: I = V/R.

mean = subtotal / n_items
    speed = meters / seconds
Density has units of mass/volume, and flow has units of volume/time.
The train covers 480 kilometres in 4 hours, or 120 kilometres per hour.
Frequency is the number of cycles divided by the elapsed time: f = n/t.
Power is the rate of doing work, with dimensions of energy/time.
The pump moves 900 litres in 30 minutes, or 30 litres per minute.
quiet: Voltage is found from Ohm's law as current times resistance: V = IR.

area = subtotal * n_items
    name = first + last
The form asks for name/address, and the menu offers soup and/or salad.
The train carries 480 passengers in 4 carriages on the morning run.
Momentum is the mass multiplied by the velocity: p = mv.
Work is force applied over a distance, with dimensions of energy.
The pump has 900 parts and 30 seals, all made of steel.

notes: Probes: 'a = v/t' 0.68, code 'total / count' 0.62, 'length/time' 0.54, 'distance / time' 0.41, '5 hours, or 60 miles per hour' 0.35; multiplication 0.01-0.03, a file path and 'and/or' 0.007, 'ratio of width to height' 0.04. One division in words-only form ('total requests / requests per host') scored 0.06, so it is not every '/'.
